name: Mighty Guard
doc: Mighty Guard (Iron Giant's and Behemoth's enemy attack; the act family, Drain's master, Shell's scaled particles): once its children are gone the actor pools and the stage darkening in, then one emitter per action target - its sound, the actor system around its target (its particles scaled by the target's height), the master's release, the result (the statuses); after the last target a wait, the darkening out. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag078_mighty_guard.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the stage in task; after the last action its wait, the stage out task; the actor counters cleared every tick

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action target: its sound, the actor system (its particles scaled by the target's height), the master's release, the result; the master's wait and the stage darkening

groups.label: Actor system
groups.doc: At the emitter's start: Start, Length (ticks), Mode (0: the targets' positions)

groups.label: Particle scale
groups.doc: The target's height times this (4096: unit size), clamped

groups.label: Stage darkening
groups.doc: In (before the first action) and out (after the wait): Level, Step a tick

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next target at this tick

params.label: Result tick
params.doc: The action result (the statuses) from this tick

params.label: Wait
params.doc: After the last target, the darkening out after these ticks

tasks.doc: One per action target: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sound, the actor system, the master's release, the result.
The stage darkening in (the port's task: the four stage group words up a step a tick).
The stage darkening out (the port's task: from its level down a step a tick to 0).

not_editable.label: Actor data
not_editable.doc: The actor data (exe data, relocated once)
